guides.definition: Creates a Pester Describe/It test with one explicit expected value. Requires the Pester module in the active PowerShell environment; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: suiteName
parameters.description: Quoted name for the behavior group.

parameters.name: behavior
parameters.description: Quoted sentence describing the expected behavior.

parameters.name: actual
parameters.description: Expression whose result should be checked.

examples.title: Verify a calculated value
examples.explanation: Describe groups related behavior, It names the observable behavior, and Should performs the assertion.

guides.definition: Adds Pester BeforeAll and AfterAll hooks around shared test state. Requires the Pester module in the active PowerShell environment; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: setup
parameters.description: Statements that establish shared test state.

parameters.name: teardown
parameters.description: Statements that release or reset shared state.

examples.title: Manage a temporary test directory
examples.explanation: BeforeAll runs once before the tests in its block; AfterAll performs matching cleanup once the block finishes.

guides.definition: Replaces a command in Pester scope and verifies how often it was invoked. Requires the Pester module in the active PowerShell environment; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: commandName
parameters.description: Command that Pester should replace and observe.

parameters.name: mockBody
parameters.description: Value or statements returned by the mock.

examples.title: Mock a service lookup
examples.explanation: Mock supplies a controlled implementation while Should -Invoke checks the interaction contract.
